question: Abdul paid ₹5,832 to a bank after a few years. He had taken a loan of ₹5,000 at the rate of 8% per annum, which was to be compounded annually. Find the time (in years).
solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 5,000

Amount = Rs. 5,832

Rate = 8% p.a.

Formula Used:

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100 100 )Time

Calculation: 

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100 100 )Time

⇒ 5832 = 5000 × (1 + 8/100 100 )Time

⇒ 5832/5000 = (108/100)Time

⇒ 729/625 = (27/25)Time

⇒ (27/25)² = (27/25)Time

Since the base is the same we can compare the power raised.

⇒ Time = 2 years.

∴ ₹5,000 becomes ₹5,832 at a rate of 8% per annum in 2 years.
